WITH cutoffs AS (
    SELECT session,
           MIN(CASE WHEN path IN ('/detail', '/complete') THEN stamp END) AS first_target,
           MIN(CASE WHEN path IN ('/detail/', '/complete/') THEN stamp END) AS first_slash_target
    FROM main.activity_log
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT c.session, c.first_target, c.first_slash_target, COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.search_type <> '' THEN 1 END) AS typed_rows,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.search_type <> '' AND (c.first_target IS NULL OR a.stamp < c.first_target) THEN 1 END) AS typed_before,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.stamp < c.first_target THEN 1 END) AS any_before,
       MIN(a.stamp) AS first_stamp,
       MAX(a.stamp) AS last_stamp
FROM cutoffs AS c
JOIN main.activity_log AS a ON c.session = a.session
GROUP BY c.session, c.first_target, c.first_slash_target
ORDER BY c.session

WITH session_cutoffs AS (
    SELECT session,
           MIN(CASE WHEN path IN ('/detail', '/complete') THEN stamp END) AS first_target_stamp
    FROM main.activity_log
    GROUP BY session
),
counted_events AS (
    SELECT s.session,
           e.path,
           e.search_type,
           COUNT(e.search_type) OVER (PARTITION BY s.session) AS event_count
    FROM session_cutoffs AS s
    LEFT JOIN main.activity_log AS e
      ON e.session = s.session
     AND e.search_type <> ''
     AND (s.first_target_stamp IS NULL OR e.stamp < s.first_target_stamp)
)
SELECT DISTINCT session, path, search_type
FROM counted_events
WHERE event_count = (SELECT MIN(event_count) FROM counted_events)
ORDER BY session, path, search_type
LIMIT -1
